summary: Mass Effect franchise entries added as supplemental sourced guide rows; Sami did not list these in the locked personal spine.

entries.title: Mass Effect
entries.definitive_edition: Mass Effect Legendary Edition on Windows, plus original Windows for Pinnacle Station only

emulation.notes: Native Windows Legendary Edition is primary; original Windows only for Pinnacle Station.

primary.why: Legendary Edition is the highest-fidelity route for the first Mass Effect, with 4K-optimized remastered single-player content and extensive visual, technical, combat, Mako, and loading updates. The only completeness conflict is Pinnacle Station, which is absent from Legendary Edition, so original Windows is preserved as a secondary route for that DLC only.
primary.how_to_play: Use Mass Effect Legendary Edition on Windows for the main playthrough. If Pinnacle Station is part of the archive target, install the original Windows version separately and play only that DLC.

secondary.exclusive_content: Pinnacle Station DLC, absent from Mass Effect Legendary Edition.
secondary.what_to_play: Play only Pinnacle Station in the original Windows version.
secondary.why: Pinnacle Station was not included in Legendary Edition because the source data was lost/corrupted.

entries.remaster_caveats: Legendary Edition omits Pinnacle Station. Do not call it a literally complete all-DLC version of Mass Effect 1.

entries.title: Mass Effect Galaxy

primary.why: Mass Effect Galaxy is documented as an iOS-only spin-off set between Mass Effect and Mass Effect 2. It has since been removed from the iOS App Store, so the original iOS release is the only sourced official route.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legitimately retained iOS install on compatible legacy hardware if available; otherwise preserve captures and metadata rather than claiming a normal current purchase route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Removed from the iOS App Store; do not present as normally purchasable.

entries.title: Mass Effect 2
entries.definitive_edition: Mass Effect Legendary Edition on Windows

primary.why: Mass Effect 2 released on Windows, Xbox 360, and PlayStation 3, and was remastered in Legendary Edition. Windows Legendary Edition is the highest-fidelity complete route because it includes over 40 single-player DLC items across the trilogy and has a well-supported PC release.
primary.how_to_play: Use Mass Effect Legendary Edition on Windows with all included single-player DLC. Use original releases only for comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use the original only for presentation comparison or mod research.

entries.title: Mass Effect Infiltrator

primary.why: Mass Effect Infiltrator is a mobile third-person shooter documented for iOS, Android, BlackBerry 10, and Windows Phone. iOS is the original release route and the best archival target unless a retained Android/Windows Phone build is specifically being preserved.
primary.how_to_play: Use a legitimately retained iOS install on compatible legacy hardware if available. If unavailable, preserve metadata/captures and do not claim a normal current purchase route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Mobile storefront availability may be limited; verify retained install access before promising playability.

entries.title: Mass Effect 3
entries.definitive_edition: Mass Effect Legendary Edition on Windows, plus original Windows for multiplayer only

emulation.notes: Native Windows Legendary Edition for single-player; original Windows for multiplayer documentation.

primary.why: Mass Effect 3 released on Windows, Xbox 360, PlayStation 3, and Wii U, then was remastered in Legendary Edition. Windows Legendary Edition is the highest-fidelity single-player route with included story DLC, but the remaster omits the original multiplayer mode, so original Windows is preserved as a secondary route for multiplayer only.
primary.how_to_play: Use Mass Effect Legendary Edition on Windows for the single-player campaign and story DLC. Use original Windows Mass Effect 3 only if documenting Galaxy at War multiplayer.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original Mass Effect 3 multiplayer mode, absent from Legendary Edition.
secondary.what_to_play: Play or document only multiplayer/Galaxy at War if current access works.
secondary.why: Mass Effect 3 had multiplayer, which was not brought into Legendary Edition.

entries.remaster_caveats: Legendary Edition is single-player only for Mass Effect 3; do not present it as preserving the multiplayer mode.

entries.title: Mass Effect: Andromeda

primary.why: Mass Effect: Andromeda released on PlayStation 4, Windows, and Xbox One. The Windows route has the highest capture/settings ceiling and supports the full single-player and multiplayer package.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version through EA/Steam with patches installed. Verify current multiplayer/service behavior before documenting online modes.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster replacing the Windows route is logged.
